<thought>Based on the NMR data, the molecule contains a carbonyl (≈197 ppm), an aromatic methyl (≈2.23 ppm, 3 H), two methylene groups (triplets at 2.81 and 2.98 ppm, each 2 H) and nine aromatic protons. The carbon count (16 C) fits a structure with two phenyl rings, one bearing a methyl substituent, linked through a carbonyl to a phenethyl chain. The most consistent SMILES is Cc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)CCc2ccccc2.</thought>
<final_answer>Cc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)CCc2ccccc2</final_answer>
